headline: The Iran standoff over Hormuz shipping is unchanged, with no new attacks confirmed today, so there is nothing new to do.
summary: No new confirmed attacks in the Gulf were found today, though GPS jamming there is high again and air traffic over the UAE looks lower than usual; we could not confirm why. Microsoft's outage is fixed and was a software bug, and Coles stores are trading while it investigates its cyber incident. Locally it is calm: Moderate fire danger in the Hills today and tomorrow, no fire bans, and today's CFS grass fires in the region had no warnings. Thursday looks windier (gusts in the 50s km/h), worth keeping an eye on.
